review.note: The question names Blitz Automaton but Autonomous Assembler is attached. Swap the attached card and citation to Blitz Automaton (19f344ee-031d-4346-9553-c5d32b02df43), which carries the identical 2022-10-14 ruling.

question: If an effect lets me cast artifact spells from my graveyard, can I cast a prototyped Blitz Automaton from my graveyard?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: the prototype ability functions in any zone the spell could be cast from.
expected.answer: The prototype ability functions in any zone that the spell could be cast from. For example, if an effect allows you to cast artifact spells from your graveyard, you could cast a prototyped Blitz Automaton from your graveyard.
